method: Researcher first-pass comparison of core claims against published institutional pages. Even CORROBORATED core history is not a sentence-by-sentence complete fact-check, independent French editorial certification or owner authorization.
exception_policy: Unverified and date-sensitive claims remain held. Partial publication requires real editor's paragraph decision and exact-revision owner authorization; zero automatically accepted.
